confident.label: Confident
confident.prompt_modifier: Speak with absolute confidence and certainty. Emphasize key words. Authoritative tone.

angry.label: Angry
angry.prompt_modifier: Speak with anger and frustration. Use sharp intonation. Emphasize words with intensity.

sarcastic.label: Sarcastic
sarcastic.prompt_modifier: Deliver with heavy sarcasm. Use ironic tone. Mock and joke while speaking.

sad.label: Sad
sad.prompt_modifier: Speak with sadness and melancholy. Use slower pace. Emphasize emotional weight.

mysterious.label: Mysterious
mysterious.prompt_modifier: Speak mysteriously and enigmatically. Pause for effect. Use hushed, intense tone.

humorous.label: Humorous
humorous.prompt_modifier: Deliver with humor and wit. Use comedic timing. Make it entertaining and funny.

desperate.label: Desperate
desperate.prompt_modifier: Speak desperately and urgently. Show desperation in voice. Emphasize urgency.
